notes: R34 targets identifier consistency across authentication, item management, reporting, and audit domains. E5 demonstrates that emergency operational overrides (Concrete Mixer maintenance window) can supersede standard rules. CONTEXT evidence (E9-E14) consistently highlights tension between formal specification identifiers and warehouse-facing operational aliases, but no PRIMARY evidence confirms whether these should be unified or separated. The requirement cannot be fully operationalized without resolving whether identifier consistency means single unified representation or controlled mapping between formal and operational forms."
